name: @temporal-architect/serve-ui
description: Build-only package: bundles @temporal-architect/visualizer into the single-file HTML asset embedded in the twf-serve Go binary (packages/twf-serve/ui/index.html). Never published — the serve UI is a packaging format, not a library. Mirrors packages/webview, but emits one self-contained HTML file (vite-plugin-singlefile) instead of the VS Code IIFE.
